_comment: Mutations that remove the guarantees added by the portfolio risk-reporting fix:
the endpoint must report the risk state the trading gate actually reads.
A and B are the SAME guarantee in two branches (the paper branch and the
live-exchange branch each used to hardcode consecutive_losses=0). C is the
aggregation rule inside the helper: the counter must be the MAX across the
population, because the account is blocked when ANY controller is over the
limit. D is the controller no longer publishing the reason. E and F are the
reason not being surfaced in the paper branch and the live Redis fallback.
G is the mode filter being removed, so a PAPER controller's equity is
reported as the LIVE balance again -- the leak this fix exists to close.
H is the helper no longer ignoring a stale reason on an ALLOWED controller
(the RiskManager deliberately keeps the last refusal reason after the gate
re-opens, so an allowed controller must never contribute a reason).
I is the single-key fallback dropping the published unrealized PnL again.
J is the aggregate fallback no longer populating the counter and the reason
in the dict it maps to the schema.
K is the controller publishing a reason even while the ACCOUNT gate is open
-- which would put a stale or per-symbol reason next to an open account.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/portfolio_risk_reporting.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: A: the paper branch reports a hardcoded 0 again
mutations.needle:
# The REAL counter the controllers publish -- not a hardcoded 0.
            consecutive_losses=paper_losses,

mutations.label: B: the live-exchange branch reports a hardcoded 0 again
mutations.needle:
# The REAL counter the live controllers publish.
            consecutive_losses=live_losses,

mutations.label: C: the counter is no longer the MAX across the population
D: the controller no longer publishes the reason
E: the paper branch no longer surfaces the reason
F: the live Redis fallback no longer surfaces the reason
G: the mode filter is removed, so paper equity leaks into the live balance
mutations.replace: # MUTANT: the mode filter is gone.

mutations.label: H: a stale reason on an ALLOWED controller is no longer ignored
mutations.replace: # MUTANT: the stale-reason guard is gone.

mutations.label: I: the single-key fallback drops the published unrealized PnL again
J: the aggregate fallback no longer populates the counter and the reason
K: the controller publishes a reason even while the ACCOUNT gate is open
